description:
Query detailed evidence strings linking targets to diseases.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table evidence — one record = one evidence string, i.e. one target-disease assertion from one data source.
Key: sourceId, id.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error); disease_id accepts ot disease or disease name (resolved; unknown -> error); datasource_id accepts ot datasource (resolved; unknown -> error); datatype_id accepts ot datatype (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by score desc within sourceId, then id asc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Rows with unknown score, publicationYear are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Evidence strings of the 23 OT 25.09 data sources; absence means no evidence in these sources, not a negative finding.

datasource_id.description: Accepts ot_datasource; resolved to one identifier (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

datatype_id.description: Accepts ot_datatype; resolved to one identifier (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

disease_id.description: Accepts ot_disease, disease_name; resolved to one ot_disease (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

min_score.description: Keeps rows with score >= this value; unknown values never pass.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
